data.reason: The formal artifacts disagree on this point (ART_3, ART_6, ART_9 vs ART_1, ART_2, ART_5, ART_7, ART_10), and no source evidence is available to adjudicate.
data.requirement: Verbatim RFC 9110 text specifying whether idempotence is defined over observable responses, over server state, or over both is needed to determine whether event-log deduplication is a separate, stronger property or subsumed under RFC idempotence.
